facts.text: John mentions his family consists of himself, his wife, and their children.

evidence.quote: Yeah, my family is awesome - me, the missus, and the kids.

facts.text: John states that his family supports him even during difficult times.

evidence.quote: Even when times are hard, they always have my back.

facts.text: John describes his family's shared activities as including outdoor activities and indoor entertainment.

evidence.quote: We love being outdoors - going for hikes, hanging out at the park, having picnics - plus playing board games and having movie nights at home.

facts.text: John mentions that his family is the best thing ever, according to his statement.
